entries.text: Seven ranked results-corpus bundles that recorded wrong values from hand-written variant or loader bugs (ClickHouse Local CoffeeShop TM1 at SF0.01, SF0.1 and SF1; ClickHouse Local TPC-DI AQ6 and AQ3 at SF0.01, SF0.1 and SF1; DataFusion ClickBench SF1 empty-string loading) carry the new `defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result` known-defect id in their submission manifests and drop out of rankings as `known_defective_data`; the id is accepted by submission validation. The CoffeeShop and TPC-DI SF0.01 documented shallow cohorts now list DuckDB alone. `results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md` records the cause per group and why the ClickHouse `map_access` bundles are not flagged.
